title: Elastic Stack 9.5.6 released
summary: Read about the updates and bug fixes that have been included in this release.
body_markdown:
Version 9.5.6 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you[upgrade to this latest version](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/upgrade) . We recommend 9.5.6 over the previous versions 9.5.5


For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to[the release notes](https://www.elastic.co/docs/release-notes) .


These releases contain security fixes. For details, refer to the Elastic Security Advisories at[https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31](https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31) .
